title: The Serre fibre homotopy sequence including components
statement: Let $p:E\to B$ be a continuous map of k-spaces [lem-coef-realization-finite-limits] with the right lifting property against $D^m\times\{0\}\hookrightarrow D^m\times[0,1]$ for every $m\geq0$ (a Serre fibration). For any $e\in E$, put $b=p(e)$ and $F=p^{-1}(b)$, with the k-space fibre topology. There are natural connecting maps and an exact sequence $\cdots\to\pi_{n+1}(B,b)\to\pi_n(F,e)\to\pi_n(E,e)\to\pi_n(B,b)\to\cdots\to\pi_1(B,b)\to\pi_0(F)\to\pi_0(E)\to\pi_0(B)$, with group exactness where groups occur and pointed-set exactness at the remaining terms. Homotopy groups and components have the continuous cubical definition of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. Paths in $B$ lift after specifying their initial point in $E$, inducing bijections of fibre-component sets along paths. The loop action of $\pi_1(B,b)$ on $\pi_0(F)$ has orbit set canonically equal to the set of components of $E$ whose image is the component of $b$; the stabilizer of the component containing $e$ is the image of $\pi_1(E,e)\to\pi_1(B,b)$. A commutative map of Serre fibrations induces compatible maps of these sequences, actions and path-transport bijections. No connectedness of $B$ or nonemptiness of fibres outside the image components is assumed.
